brief.headline: FSB touts foiled airbase drone plot as Moscow hit by mass strike
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels blanketed the day with a coordinated FSB claim of having thwarted Ukrainian FPV-drone attacks on strategic airbases, while simultaneously acknowledging a 300+ drone Ukrainian assault on the Moscow region that killed three civilians. Sentiment split sharply: triumphant on internal security (net +75) but grim on Ukrainian strikes (net -67).

developments.title: FSB claims it foiled FPV-drone plot against airbases
developments.body: At least seven channels ran near-identical claims that the FSB pre-empted Ukrainian FPV-drone attacks on strategic airbases in Amur and Chelyabinsk regions, seizing 24 drones with 'Western'/'NATO' neural-network components and detaining operatives. The heavy uniformity and Rybar's 184k-view lead post suggest a centrally distributed security-services narrative rather than independent reporting.

developments.title: Mass Ukrainian drone strike on Moscow region kills three
developments.body: Channels reported Ukraine launched 300+ (one post cited 350+) drones at the Moscow region; Russia claimed 81-89 intercepted. Kotsnews and WarGonzo said three civilians were killed and six wounded, with fires in five houses in Pionersky — figures MoD-adjacent and unconfirmed. This was the day's most-viewed post (Two Majors, 288k).

developments.title: Russian strikes on Chornomorsk/Odesa ports; internal skepticism
developments.body: Multiple channels claimed Russian drones and precision weapons damaged Chornomorsk grain/oil terminals, ferries and cargo ships over two days, allegedly halting Kernel exports. Notably, Rybar's own analyst (188k views) questioned the strike claims, citing lack of visible damage — a rare intra-channel dissent worth flagging.

developments.title: Britain sanctions GRU officers and Rybar staff
developments.body: Rybar reported UK sanctions targeting Russian GRU officers and its own channel staff over cyber operations. The founder responded that sanctions rest on 'distorted information' and that three team members had already left before the designation — a self-referential deflection.

developments.title: European-Ukrainian air defense coalition framed as NATO cover
developments.body: Several channels flagged formation of a nine-nation-plus-Ukraine anti-ballistic-missile coalition and a 'NATO-Ukraine integrated air defense' effort, framing Western tech as operating 'under civilian cover.' Two Majors also cited Germany funding 50,000 AI-enabled Shrike FPV drones for Ukraine.

developments.title: Zaporizhzhia/Dobropillya advances claimed on frontline
developments.body: Poddubny and WarGonzo claimed Russian offensives near Dobropillya and expansion west of Novoselivka toward Velykomykhailivka, plus airspace control over Kostyantynivka. All frontline posts (7) skewed uniformly positive (net +100), consistent with routine advance-messaging; unconfirmed.

narrative_watch.title: 'Western components' framing on seized drones
narrative_watch.body: The FSB airbase story repeatedly emphasizes 'NATO'/'Western neural-network' modules in the 24 seized drones, tying domestic sabotage to foreign backers and justifying escalation rhetoric.

narrative_watch.title: Refugee-return pressure as EU/NATO decline signal
narrative_watch.body: Channels amplify EU temporary-protection tightening and Polish calls for draft-age Ukrainians to return, framing Europe as exhausted and complicit in forced mobilization.

narrative_watch.title: Calls to strike Western targets directly
narrative_watch.body: Starshe Eddy argued Russia should strike Western targets supporting Ukraine to deter NATO — an escalationist frame worth tracking among the hawkish milbloggers.

mood_lines.text: Sharp swing to +75 on the coordinated FSB airbase-plot win and Putin's People's Front appearance; security-services triumphalism dominates.
Grim at -67 over the 300+ drone Moscow assault and civilian deaths; some posts pivot to praising counterintelligence.
Buoyant on Chornomorsk/Odesa port claims, though Rybar's own analyst openly doubted the reported damage.
Negative at -50; air-defense coalition, UK sanctions on Rybar, and refugee rules framed as hostile Western escalation.
Uniformly positive (+100); routine claims of advances near Dobropillya and Zaporizhzhia, all unconfirmed.
Minimal (2 posts), aimed at Ukrainian army discipline and media censorship, not internal Russian targets.

flag_texts.title: Russia-internal sentiment jumps +135 to net +75
flag_texts.body: The swing is driven almost entirely by the multi-channel FSB airbase-plot claim (16 internal posts, 13 positive), amplified by Putin's People's Front forum appearance. The uniformity suggests centrally coordinated messaging rather than organic mood.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation rumours and Putin criticism stay silent
flag_texts.body: No posts touched mobilisation rumours or criticism of Putin; the only 'mobilisation' subtopic post praised the Popular Front as a supply mechanism, and Putin coverage was entirely favorable.
